propositions: Deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus with five defect classes (absent asserted capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) must be built and stored in runs/e2_mutant_corpus.jsonl with paired controls and mutation metadata
Pure counting helpers classify_pair and run_validity in e2_counting.py must handle PASS/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE verdicts and enforce ≥0.20 INDETERMINATE run-validity cap with golden unit test coverage

Benchmark harness run_e2_benchmark.py must implement store isolation via git clone --local to prevent contamination of real .tickets-tracker and include emit_baseline guard that blocks baseline output when run validity exceeds threshold
Pre-registered thresholds in runs/e2_thresholds.json must define per-class detection and blocking-FP targets for all five defect classes plus INDETERMINATE cap before harness execution

Live LLM batch baseline (~100-run gate sweep) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder (change #798, MERGED) which accumulates detection/FP signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost

Deterministic half (mutant corpus, thresholds, counting helpers, store-isolation seams, golden tests) designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 is intentionally not landed on main since harness only drives rejected batch
